scope: Independent review of history.py empirical experiment only. Certificate proofs/implementation are outside this review. Read AGENTS, README introduction, PROJECT_STATE relevant status, reviewed D6/K1/K2, reused Exact/Compressed/Model and stream/backend paths.

findings.finding: The probe loop caught replay integrity ValueError as unsupported parameter support, allowing a later mismatched/incomplete/out-of-order replay to be hidden in a completed case.
findings.repair: ReplayIntegrityError derives from RuntimeError and propagates out of the probe support handler. Tests inject a later-probe integrity error and assert propagation.

findings.finding: Intermediate experiment summaries could say completed before all requested cases and final source verification; final source failure could leave a falsely completed summary.
findings.repair: Intermediate summaries remain running; final verification/plot failure writes unresolved; only final verified summary can complete and binds build receipts.

findings.finding: Pilot contains two round_limit field fits and one failed embedded low-noise arm; point diagnostics must not imply convergence or physical exclusion.
findings.repair: Specification explicitly retains round_limit/no_descent as convergence limitations and labels gradient/query projections local GN diagnostics. Original pilot remains unresolved and source archived. Failed-backend prefix/hash/publication diagnostics were added for new runs.

comprehension.chronology: Each direct objective pass creates a fresh StimulusStream at physical sample zero, retains actual observation intervals/order, transports state and full origin Jacobians between chunks, and verifies the complete prefix byte hash before a successful pass returns.
comprehension.truth_separation: Cell definition/truth belongs to source generation and final scoring; estimator/field objectives use public calibration, original prior, and observations. Directions and fit starts use likelihood geometry/current estimate, not truth.
comprehension.likelihood: Compressed and direct objectives share original mean/root, once-only standard Gaussian prior, residual sigma and common parameter point. Common Gaussian normalization constants cancel from NLL differences. No posterior is reintroduced as independent evidence.
comprehension.geometry: The Cholesky congruence equals C^-1 fP C^-T. Gradient dual norms use P^-1. Query variance ratios use the same direct-anchor query row; separate transport metrics compare endpoint state and query transport. The minus P^-1 gradient-defect projection predicts compression-minus-direct displacement locally only.
comprehension.snapshot: The shallow field copy is safe under replacement-only field.update; count/live-state parity is checked; tests confirm active context and checkpoints are unchanged.
comprehension.scope: Sampled NLL range is not a uniform oscillation enclosure and cannot discharge K2. Direct evaluation is binary64/libm, GN precision is local, and no global mode, physical coverage, lifetime availability or M23 qualification is claimed.

validation.command: Inline independent random 16D SPD matrix witness
validation.result: Whitening congruence and both same-query variance formulas match explicit inverse calculations to 1e-13.

128-row versus 4096-row chunks are byte-identical; repeated full replay verifies twice; chronology violation rejected. One exploratory call omitted explicit slice start and correctly failed the Exact-specific ordered-slice interface; rerun with Exact-compatible explicit zero passed.
